summary.text: Kathy Steinhoff is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 45, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Steinhoff is a National Board Certified Teacher who worked for Columbia Public Schools.

paragraphs.text: Kathy Steinhoff graduated from Truman High School and earned degrees from the University of Missouri, Columbia, a bachelor's degree in 1987 and a graduate degree in 1992.
She is a National Board Certified Teacher and has worked as a teacher for Columbia Public Schools.
Her listed affiliations include the Missouri National Education Association, the National Education Association, the National Council for Teachers of Mathematics and Moms Demand Action.

In the Missouri House, Steinhoff was assigned to the Budget Committee, the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee, the Pensions Committee, the Joint Committee on Education and the Joint Committee on Public Employee Retirement for 2025-2026.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired educator and said her legislative work has focused on budget, education, pensions and taxes.
She listed her three key campaign messages as quality public education, gun violence prevention and income redistribution.
